demo.unavailable: Toast in the tutorial demo, shown when the user picks a tray menu item the demo does not run (Library, Settings, Language and so on). It tells them the item works in the real app. A short phrase, no full stop in English.
demo.tray_icon: Accessible name and tooltip of the fake tray icon on the demo's fake taskbar. It stands for the real WidgetBoard tray icon; keep the product name as the app uses it. 3 to 5 words.
